notes.title: Playtest is over. Thanks to every participant ❤️
notes.content:
Playtest Completed – Sharing the Results!

Friends, a huge thank you to everyone who played, streamed, discussed, and shared their impressions! Your support and feedback are incredibly important to us.

Playtest Results:

Access granted to: 3,364 users, played: 1,359

Survey responses: 550 respondents

Average game rating: 8.2 out of 10

Would recommend to friends: 95.6% of users (similar to Steam reviews). This is simply amazing!

Content: Over 40 streams and Let's Plays on YouTube and Twitch – all without advertising or announcements!

We see this as a great indicator that you truly enjoy the game, and it motivates us to keep moving forward.

What's Next?

We are now taking some time for minor improvements based on your feedback. We need to address several issues to make the game even better.

We’ll be back with updates soon.

Thank you for your support and trust! We are working for you! ❤️

notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT: TESTING CLOSES IN 2 DAYS! ⏳
notes.content:
Friends, we want to inform you that the second phase of testing is coming to an end. Access to the game will be closed on Monday at 5:00 GMT. This means you only have 2 days left to jump in, play, and share your feedback!

After testing closes:

- It will no longer be possible to request access to the game.

- The game will become unavailable for download and play.

If you haven’t had a chance to join the testing yet, now is the time! Make sure to enjoy the game this weekend and leave your feedback.

A HUGE THANK YOU! ❤️
We are incredibly grateful to everyone who participated in the testing. Your feedback, bug reports, and support have helped us improve the game. Thank you for being part of this journey!

WHAT’S NEXT? 🔧
After testing closes, we’ll focus on refining the game based on your feedback. Stay tuned for updates—there’s still a lot of exciting stuff ahead!

Happy gaming, and may this weekend be filled with unforgettable moments!
— The Cyberhead Team �

P.S. Don’t forget to share your thoughts on social media, streams, or discussions. Your opinion matters to us!

notes.title: UPDATE IS LIVE! 🎮✨
notes.content:
UPDATE IS LIVE! 🎮✨

Friends, we’re thrilled to announce the second wave of testing! Access is now granted to everyone who requested it. Alongside this, we’ve rolled out an update packed with fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. With your help, we’ve gathered tons of feedback, but this update focuses on the most frequent issues:

Improved Controls: “Random falls” are now much rarer. We’ve trained Jimmy to be steadier on narrow surfaces and jump higher/farther. The throw cursor is less likely to vanish, and controller movements feel more responsive.

Locations: Fixed issues in certain areas and cutscenes for smoother gameplay.

Added Achievements: You asked, we delivered! We’ve also added exclusive achievements only for testers.

Bugs: Conducted a massive cleanup across all locations.

Graphics: Reduced “blurriness” for sharper, cleaner visuals.

STREAMS & DISCUSSIONS 🚀
We allow and encourage streams, reviews, and discussions about the playtest! Share your excitement, report bugs, and tell us what you love (or don’t). Your feedback drives us!

WHAT’S NEXT? 🔧
We’ll keep rolling out fixes. Once we’ve polished the most critical areas, the game will launch as a free demo for everyone to play!

THANK YOU! ❤️
A massive thanks to everyone participating in the playtest. Your support and feedback help us improve daily. Let’s create something truly awesome together!

Happy gaming, and keep the feedback coming!
— The Cyberhead Team 🎉

notes.title: Critical error correction
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Thank you for joining, and for those who haven't joined the journey with Jimmy yet, please add the game to your Wishlist.

If you were unable to complete the game or found critical bugs related to DRD12 and SM6, please update the game. 

Fixed:

1. the game now runs on DirectX11, which will avoid critical bugs and crashes
2. You were hanging on a location with air conditioning or couldn't get down to the sewers - fixed
3. If you had no sound of switches turning on and off - fixed
4. If the game did not start and swore at DirectX, video card and other - try again. Everything should work.

[h1][b][u]Be sure to update the game![/u][/b][/h1]

Otherwise, small optimization fixes have been added to maintain stable FPS.

We'll continue to release updates and add content so you can enjoy the game.

Your Cyberheads

notes.title: Fixing the gamepad
notes.content:
Hi,

we have worked on the control and managed to make it more comfortable, but so far only on XBOX gamepad and analogs. 

List of changes:
- Interactions tooltips. Now they are displayed almost always correctly when playing (errors are possible)
- Smoother and more responsive controls
- Responsive control when sprinting
- A little bit of entourage at the beginning
- Sewer pipes are now much easier to pass through
- Clinging to ladders is now easier

Minor edits to the map.

If you have difficulties in passing, you have found a bug - write in the community, we each review it.

Be sure to add the game to your wishlist, it will help us find funding for the main version of the game. 

Thank you
Best wishes
Cyberhead team

notes.title: ONE WAY HOME. A game about a little boy in the age of the apocalypse.
notes.content:
Imagine you're a little boy who happened to survive at the very beginning of the apocalypse.

You will have to make your way through the hordes of the dead, puzzles and difficulties to find the right way home.

The game is developed by enthusiasts without funding and we are very eager to show and tell this story. 

Download the demo, leave feedback and add to your wishlist. 

Regards, Cyberhead games team
